content.thinking:
I'm looking at why the licence check never changes the result: an MSB under the industry restriction always gets escalated, which is stricter than the approval the msb-licensed rule gives, so the verified licence has no effect. I'm now weighing whether a verified MSB should be approved without an EDD referral, or always escalated under 5.2, and the first option I'm considering is keeping the current behaviour where every MSB goes to escalation.

I'm weighing the second option: a verified licence would exempt an MSB from the 5.2 escalation. The catch is unknowns, since "not licence_verified is yes" could stay incomplete when the licence status is unknown, so I'd rather check for "no" or "unknown" directly, the way the ID-verified rule already does, so an unknown licence still escalates.

I'm checking whether the SOP sections cited by the rule can be changed to 5.2 and 5.3 together, but a replaced rule should keep its id, sop and text, so the answer will be recorded alongside it instead. The msb-licensed rule still produces approve and can stay as the smallest edit. Once licence_verified is in the logic, a verified MSB gets approved and an unverified one gets escalated. I'm also weighing a third option, but 5.3 doesn't clearly support it, so I'll stick with the two options.

I'm settling on how the question and the two options should read: keeping every MSB going to EDD means 5.3 changes nothing, while letting a verified licence skip EDD means a verified MSB can be approved and an unverified or unchecked one is still escalated.

I'm settling on the second option, where a verified licence means the MSB is no longer escalated under 5.2.

parsed.question: When a money services business's state licence has been verified, can it be approved without going to Enhanced Due Diligence, or does 5.2 still send it to EDD?

options.option: No, every MSB still goes to EDD
options.says: 5.2 sends every money services business to EDD whether or not its licence is verified, so 5.3 never changes an outcome and checking the licence is not needed for the decision.

options.option: Yes, a verified licence skips EDD
options.says: A money services business whose state licence has been verified is no longer escalated under 5.2 and can be approved if nothing else applies. One whose licence is unverified or not yet checked is still escalated, and virtual currency businesses are still escalated.

rule.text: Restricted industries (money services businesses, virtual currency): escalate.
